title: Introduce declarative ProviderRegistry abstraction for TTS and video models

violation.problem: src/tts/ lacks a provider registry or factory abstraction, forcing callers across CLI, TUI, sidecar, and Studio to hardcode imperative new GeminiTTSProvider(...) calls.
violation.expectedSolution: Export a ProviderRegistry class and getTTSProvider factory helper in src/tts/ allowing declarative provider registration and lookup.

steps: In src/tts/, implement and export a ProviderRegistry class supporting register() and get() for ITTSProvider instances.
Export ProviderRegistry and getTTSProvider from src/tts/index.ts.
Register GeminiTTSProvider as the default provider under 'gemini'.
reviewChecklist: ProviderRegistry allows registering and retrieving ITTSProvider implementations
